diagnostics.message: `mix-blend-mode` applies to SVG elements (LLP 1055.000 D19); boxes do not blend yet

`mix-blend-mode` is not drawn on ios (app.json `host.ios`) and android (app.json `host.android`): blending with a backdrop outside the SVG is not drawn; put all overlapping artwork inside one svg, or use Canvas 2D globalCompositeOperation (including multiply) inside one canvas. The node draws there as if it were unset (set at line 4; LLP 1159.000). `contract vocab mix-blend-mode` says what each host does
